title: Everyday Figurative Idioms
goal: Understand and use high-frequency Spanish idioms whose figurative meanings go beyond their literal words.

items: I can use everyday figurative idioms such as *meter la pata*, *dar en el clavo* and *tomar el pelo* accurately.
I can keep the fixed noun and article intact while conjugating the verb and placing object pronouns.
I can recognise figurative meanings without translating English idioms word for word.
